mapper.select: SELECT ROUND(start_lon, 3) AS startLon, ROUND(start_lat, 3) AS startLat, ROUND(end_lon, 3) AS endLon, ROUND(end_lat, 3) AS endLat -- COUNT(*) AS weight FROM dwd_taxi_trip WHERE start_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY startLon, startLat, endLon, endLat -- HAVING weight > 0
SELECT ROUND(end_lon, 3) AS lon, ROUND(end_lat, 3) AS lat, COUNT(*) AS intensity FROM dwd_taxi_trip WHERE end_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY lon, lat ORDER BY intensity DESC
